notesI18n.zh:
· 打开会话、加载会话列表明显变快：不再为每个会话读取整份记录（本机最大的已超过 30MB），列表从十几秒降到 1 秒以内
· 会话列表里「最近一条提问」的预览更准：长时间的工具调用之后不会再退回显示最早的那条提问
notesI18n.en:
· Sessions open and the session list loads much faster: the app no longer reads every session's whole record (the largest one here is over 30MB), cutting list time from tens of seconds to under a second
· The “last asked” preview in the session list is accurate again — it no longer falls back to the earliest question after a long tool-heavy turn
